name: NextQA
intro: NExT-QA是面向解释性视频问答的人工标注基准，从6,000个VidOR候选视频中保留5,440个交互丰富片段，并构建52,044条因果、时序和描述性问答。论文同时提供47,692道五选一题和完整开放式问答集，用Accuracy与WUPS评估模型。
build_method: 视频筛选, 三阶段人工标注, 困难干扰项生成
task_type: 视频问答, 因果推理, 时序推理
eval_feature: 因果/时序/描述问题, 多选与开放式问答, 人工标注
task_type_en: Video QA, Causal Reasoning, Temporal Reasoning
build_method_en: Video Selection, Three-stage Human Annotation, Hard Distractor Generation
eval_feature_en: Causal, Temporal, and Descriptive Questions; Multi-choice and Open-ended QA; Human Annotation
intro_en: NExT-QA is a manually annotated benchmark for explanatory video QA. It retains 5,440 interaction-rich clips from 6,000 VidOR candidates and contains 52,044 causal, temporal, and descriptive QA pairs. The paper provides 47,692 five-option questions alongside the full open-ended set, evaluated by accuracy and WUPS.
drawio_review_note: Re-reviewed against arXiv:2105.08276v2 Sections 3.1-4 and Appendix A, plus the official doc-doc/NExT-QA repository. The diagram records selection of 6,000 longer interaction-rich VidOR videos, the 7:1:2 video split, one year of causal-then-temporal-then-descriptive annotation by 100 trained undergraduates, separate question and answer roles, visible-evidence quality control, and post-processing of boring videos, yes/no balance, and counts above 20. It preserves the final 5,440 videos and 52,044 QA pairs, Sentence-BERT hard-negative construction with similarity thresholds 0.9 and 0.2, manual checking of all 47,692 five-option tuples, and separate multiple-choice accuracy versus open-ended WUPS evaluation.
